algorithm_task_failure.coverage_rule: retain every planned target-period opportunity in method-specific coverage denominator
algorithm_task_failure.fallback_rule: zero-correction fallback remains in denominator and is counted by speed-period
algorithm_task_failure.position_rule: only common correct matches enter each conditional position RMSE; record status and counts

alternative_policies_compared.decision: reject as primary; can induce outcome-dependent selection
reject without an independently approved finite loss scale; changes estimand
alternative_policies_compared.policy: impute miss as fixed large position error
retain misses in coverage and make missing primary endpoint inconclusive

data_or_engineering_failure.analysis_status: not evaluable until a same-identity technical repair completes; full matrix cannot pass with unresolved technical loss
data_or_engineering_failure.rule: retain the registered seed/case identity; only a technical repair may retry the same seed/config; never replace or draw a favorable seed

one_common_success_in_speed_stratum.freeze_blocker: minimum acceptable common support is an engineering/user decision; do not infer it from P0
one_common_success_in_speed_stratum.rule: compute the mathematically defined RMSE contrast and flag LOW_COMMON_SUPPORT

opportunity_identity_contract.algorithm_miss: retain the explicit planned row with matched=false in the method-specific coverage denominator
opportunity_identity_contract.missing_record: NOT_EVALUABLE_MISSING_OPPORTUNITY_RECORDS; do not infer it was a miss or drop it
opportunity_identity_contract.planned_registry: exact (speed_mps,target_id,period) identities from frozen truth mapping
opportunity_identity_contract.unexpected_identity: hard error; do not add a post-hoc target-period opportunity

primary_estimand.inferential_unit: independent seed; resample a complete seed cluster
primary_estimand.per_speed: RMSE_M1_minus_RMSE_Fixed_D3 on the same correctly associated target-period opportunities

zero_common_success_in_speed_stratum.confirmatory_consequence: overall position claim is INCONCLUSIVE if any planned seed lacks a required speed contrast; do not silently complete-case drop
zero_common_success_in_speed_stratum.rule: primary seed contrast is NOT_EVALUABLE_NO_COMMON_SUCCESS; preserve all opportunity and coverage records
zero_common_success_in_speed_stratum.sensitivity: report observed common-support subset descriptively; it cannot replace the registered primary result
